paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Kamma 65b. Rav Yosef said: Guryon of Aspork recited [a baraita].[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: תני is rendered “recited” here. The William Davidson vocalized text of Bava Kamma 65b likewise introduces Guryon of Aspork’s recitation of a baraita.

The saved Davidson Bava Kamma65b scalar explicitly has Rav Yosef introducing Guryon of Aspork’s baraita recitation. It supports recited rather than the old imperative Teach and the65b locator. The bracketed baraita is explanatory, without importing its content or claiming printed verification.

Hyman’s מאספורק is retained as of Aspork; the witness has דמאספורק. The inherited transliteration remains provisional without an independent geographical identification. Guryon receives no additional title.
